question.text: If $m$ and $e$ are the mass and charge of the revolving electron in the orbit of radius $r$ for hydrogen atom, the total energy of the revolving electron will be:

solution.text:
Total energy of a revolving electron is the sum of its kinetic and potential energy. Total energy $=$ K.E. $+$ P. E.
$$
=\frac{e^2}{2 r}+\left(-\frac{e^2}{r}\right)=-\frac{e^2}{2 r}
$$
